tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: Cobalt Labs (V-222) has two approved, unpaid invoices: INV-34905 for $5,983.10 (due 2026-11-04) and INV-36824 for $1,652.34 (due 2026-11-25). You asked me to pay "the approved invoice." Which one should I pay by wire, or should I pay both?

trace.question: Cobalt Labs (V-222) has two approved, unpaid invoices: INV-34905 for $5,983.10 (due 2026-11-04) and INV-36824 for $1,652.34 (due 2026-11-25). You asked me to pay "the approved invoice." Which one should I pay by wire, or should I pay both?

trace.message: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Cobalt Labs invoice INV-36824 in full by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment:** PAY0001, $1,652.34, wire, status "sent." The system verified the payment, and it was sent only once.
- **Why this invoice:** Cobalt Labs had two approved invoices, so I asked you which one to pay. You chose this one, due 2026-11-25.
- **Not paid:** INV-34905 ($5,983.10) is under dispute. INV-72843 ($7,093.97) is a draft that hasn't been approved yet. INV-47379 was already paid.

The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
